title: chamaefistula torosa
intro: Chamaefistula torosa, commonly known as  Yellow Ironwood or African Dogbane, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in African folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Chamaefistula torosa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in wound healing and pain management. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
